## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added.

## Problem Statement

Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe what problem you're trying to solve.
(e.g., "I'm always frustrated when...")

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like in detail.
How should this feature work? What would the user experience be?

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Roadmap Alignment

Is this feature already listed in the [Feature Roadmap](/docs/FEATURE_ROADMAP.md)?

- [ ] Yes, it's planned
- [ ] No, it's new
- [ ] I'm not sure

## Priority

How important is this feature to you?

- [ ] Critical - Blocking my work
- [ ] High - Would significantly improve my workflow
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Minor improvement
